li.label: Bugging feeling
li.description: Something's bugging me, but I can't put my finger on it.

li.label: Feeling off
li.description: Something feels off, but whenever I put my finger on it, it slips away...

li.label: Something is wrong
li.description: Something is wrong with me. This isn't right...

li.label: Feeling unlike myself
li.description: I don't feel like myself anymore. My memory... things don't make sense!

li.label: Not myself
li.description: My memories and who I am now don't line up. Someone messed with my mind!

li.label: Stranger to myself
li.description: I feel like a stranger to myself. What memories are my own and which ones were altered? I can't live like this!

li.label: cortex overseer
li.description: I have no say in my life anymore... unless I am willing to end it...

li.label: cortex overseer
li.description: I know it's deactivated, but it's still inside me. I will never not feel uneasy...

li.label: Free again
li.description: My cortex overseer was removed. I am finally free again!
